subject.title: feat(exec): expose knownLongFlags in safeBinProfiles config schema

question: Should OpenClaw make `tools.exec.safeBinProfiles.<bin>.knownLongFlags` a supported public operator config field?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but root policy sets a high bar for new config surface and this field changes the exec safe-bin security boundary by allowing custom profiles to mark boolean long flags as known and auto-approvable.

options.title: Approve the public field after docs formatting
options.body: Accept `knownLongFlags` as public config, require the docs formatting fix, and merge after normal owner/security review.

options.title: Keep known flags internal
options.body: Pause or close this PR and solve custom boolean/known long-option handling with a narrower design that does not expose this field.

options.title: Defer to broader safe-bin design
options.body: Hold this PR with related safe-bin PRs until maintainers settle the full custom/default safe-bin option model.

recommendation.title: Approve the public field after docs formatting
recommendation.body: Accept `knownLongFlags` as public config, require the docs formatting fix, and merge after normal owner/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: The safe-bin policy and long-option validation history most strongly points to this owner for the config/security-boundary choice.
